name: Royally Screwed
source:
With war looming, you – an omega and the kingdom's only heir – must marry to solidify your claim to the throne and quell any territorial disputes.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
战争迫在眉睫，你作为omega和王国的唯一继承人，必须通过婚姻来巩固你对王位的主张并平息任何领土争端。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
